notes.en: Odette is primarily played as an off-field support in [[element:stellar-glimmer]] teams. She casts her [[ability:skill]], follows up with its second cast to activate her Solo Dance Double's [[element:stellar-glimmer]] attacks, and then swaps off-field. While off-field, her Solo Dance Double continuously deals [[element:cryo]] and [[element:stellar-glimmer]] damage every 2s, maintains consistent [[element:cryo]] application, and enables [[element:stellar-conduct]] or [[element:stellar-swirl]] for the on-field character. [[character:odette]] requires very little field time outside of refreshing her [[ability:skill]], making her an excellent enabler for teammates that demand extended on-field presence. Her [[ability:burst]] is generally used when available for its additional damage and utility but is secondary to maintaining [[ability:skill]] uptime and the Solo Dance Double.
